verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Meltano's CLI can test plugin configuration (meltano config test) and supports DataOps practices like CI/CD, but nothing describes a dedicated sandbox/staging environment that isolates test runs from production data. Missing for 10: explicit environment/sandbox feature documentation, evidence of separate dev vs prod data isolation, and any first-party or community confirmation that pipelines can be run against sandboxed data without touching production.
